description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class DefaultMetadataHeaderKey, verifying its immutability, equality, parsing behavior, path retrieval, and comparison logic.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderKeyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultMetadataHeaderKey, testing its fundamental behaviors such as immutability, equality, parsing, path retrieval, applicability of wildcards, string representation, and comparison logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: wildcardPathHasTooFewLevels

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Ensures that parsing a null string with DefaultMetadataHeaderKey.parse() throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToParseEmptyString

methods.description: Verifies that parsing a valid JsonPointer returns the expected DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instance.

methods.name: getPathOfWildcardKey

methods.name: pathWithoutLeadingAsteriskDoesNotApplyToAllLeaves

methods.name: pathWithLeadingAsteriskAppliesToAllLeaves

methods.description: Verifies the correct ordering of DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instances based on their paths, including comparisons between specific and wildcard paths.
